an9.41:1.1: 41 ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallakesu viharati uruvelakappaṃ nāma mallānaṃ nigamo.
an9.41:1.2: athakho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya uruvelakappaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi
an9.41:1.3: uruvelakappe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
an9.41:1.4: idheva tāva tvaṃ ānanda hohi yāvāhaṃ mahāvanaṃ ajjhogāhāmi divā vihārāyāti.
an9.41:1.5: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
an9.41:1.6: athakho bhagavā mahāvanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
an9.41:2.1: athakho tapusso gahapati yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho tapusso gahapati āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
an9.41:3.1: mayaṃ bhante ānanda gihī kāmabhogino kāmārāmā kāmaratā kāmasammuditā
an9.41:3.2: tesaṃ no bhante amhākaṃ gihīnaṃ kāmabhogīnaṃ kāmārāmānaṃ kāmaratānaṃ kāmasammuditānaṃ papāto viya khāyati yadidaṃ nekkhammaṃ
an9.41:3.3: sutametaṃ bhante imasmiṃ dhammavinaye daharānaṃ daharānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ nekkhamme cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati etaṃ santanti passato
an9.41:3.4: tayidaṃ bhante imasmiṃ dhammavinaye bhikkhūnaṃ bahunā janena visabhāgo yadidaṃ nekkhammanti.
an9.41:4.1: atthi kho etaṃ gahapati kathāpābhataṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya
an9.41:4.2: āyāma gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamissāma upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocessāma
an9.41:4.3: yathā no bhagavā byākarissati tathā karissāmāti.
an9.41:5.1: evaṃ bhanteti kho tapusso gahapati āyasmato ānandassa paccassosi.
an9.41:5.2: athakho āyasmā ānando tapussena gahapatinā saddhiṃ yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

an9.41:6.3: sutametaṃ bhante imasmiṃ dhammavinaye daharānaṃ daharānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ nekkhamme cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati etaṃ santanti passato

an9.41:7.2: mayhampi kho ānanda pubbeva sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi
an9.41:7.4: tassa mayhaṃ ānanda nekkhamme cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati etaṃ santanti passato
an9.41:7.6: ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo yena me nekkhamme cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati etaṃ santanti passato
an9.41:7.8: kāmesu kho me ādīnavo adiṭṭho so ca me abahulīkato nekkhamme ca ānisaṃso anadhigato so ca me anāsevito
an9.41:7.9: tasmā me nekkhamme cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati etaṃ santanti passato
an9.41:7.11: sace kho ahaṃ kāmesu ādīnavaṃ disvā taṃ bahulīkareyyaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ adhigamma tamāseveyyaṃ
an9.41:7.12: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yaṃ me nekkhamme cittaṃ pakkhandeyya pasīdeyya santiṭṭheyya vimucceyya etaṃ santanti passato
an9.41:7.13: so kho ahaṃ ānanda aparena samayena kāmesu ādīnavaṃ disvā taṃ bahulamakāsiṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ adhigamma tamāseviṃ
an9.41:7.14: tassa mayhaṃ ānanda nekkhamme cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati etaṃ santanti passato
an9.41:7.15: so kho ahaṃ ānanda vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi
an9.41:7.16: tassa mayhaṃ ānanda iminā vihārena viharato kāmasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti svāssa me hoti ābādho
an9.41:7.17: seyyathāpi ānanda sukhino dukkhaṃ uppajjeyya yāva deva ābādhāya
an9.41:7.18: evamassa me kāmasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti svāssa me hoti ābādho.

an9.41:14.14: tassa mayhaṃ ānanda iminā vihārena viharato ākiñcaññāyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti svāssa me hoti ābādho
an9.41:14.15: seyyathāpi ānanda sukhino dukkhaṃ uppajjeyya yāva deva ābādhāya
an9.41:14.16: evamevassa me ākiñcaññāyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti svāssa me hoti ābādho.
an9.41:15.2: yannūnāhaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
an9.41:15.3: tassa mayhaṃ ānanda saññāvedayitanirodhe cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati etaṃ santanti passato
an9.41:15.5: ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo yena me saññāvedayitanirodhe cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati etaṃ santanti passato
an9.41:15.7: nevasaññānāsaññāyatane kho me ādīnavo adiṭṭho so ca me abahulīkato saññāvedayitanirodhe ca ānisaṃso anadhigato so ca me anāsevito
an9.41:15.8: tasmā me saññāvedayitanirodhe cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati etaṃ santanti passato
an9.41:15.10: sace kho ahaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatane ādīnavaṃ disvā taṃ bahulīkareyyaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhe ānisaṃsaṃ adhigamma tamāseveyyaṃ ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yaṃ me saññāvedayitanirodhe cittaṃ pakkhandeyya pasīdeyya santiṭṭheyya vimucceyya etaṃ santanti passato
an9.41:15.11: so kho ahaṃ ānanda aparena samayena nevasaññānāsaññāyatane ādīnavaṃ disvā taṃ bahulamakāsiṃ saññāvedayitanirodhe ānisaṃsaṃ adhigamma tamāseviṃ
an9.41:15.12: tassa mayhaṃ ānanda saññāvedayitanirodhe cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati etaṃ santanti passato
an9.41:15.13: so kho ahaṃ ānanda sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharāmi paññāya ca me disvā āsavā parikkhayaṃ agamaṃsu.
an9.41:16.1: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ ānanda imā nava anupubbavihārasamāpattiyo na evaṃ anulomapaṭilomaṃ samāpajjimpi vuṭṭhahimpi neva tāvāhaṃ ānanda sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ
an9.41:16.2: yato ca kho ahaṃ ānanda imā nava anupubbavihārasamāpattiyo evaṃ anulomapaṭilomaṃ samāpajjimpi vuṭṭhahimpi athāhaṃ ānanda sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ
an9.41:16.4: akuppā me cetovimutti ayamantimā jāti natthidāni punabbhavoti.
